primitives.note: Bio-Arcane Barrage empowers basic attacks with bonus magic damage based on target max health for 8s duration
next 8s of basic attacks gain range and the on-hit magic damage rider
Caustic Spittle's passive grants Kog'Maw bonus attack speed continuously (unlocked, not activated)
Q shreds target's armor and magic resistance for 4s
Void Ooze leaves a ground field for 3s that ticks a slow every 0.25s (no damage tick, but treated as ticking zone for slow only; no repeat damage)
Q and E deal damage on a fixed short delay after cast, on cooldown
Living Artillery is cast repeatedly (fast cooldown) as a separately-timed damage instance each time, not a true recast chain but multiple discrete casts
each R cast adds a mana-cost-increasing stack (up to 9), raising cost per subsequent cast
Living Artillery stacks (cost surcharge) accumulate with cap 9 and refresh/expire on an 8s timer
mana costs on all abilities, especially R's ramping cost, meaningfully limit casts within 15s
R damage scales with target's missing health (up to +50% at 60% missing) or is doubled outright below 40% max health
R has a 0.6s travel/delay before impact, distinct fixed delay per cast
the 40% max-health threshold triggering doubled damage is a threshold-based damage step

Icathian Surprise zombie-state invulnerability/movement speed is defensive/irrelevant to a damage-dealing dummy fight; only the on-death explosion could matter but requires Kog'Maw to die, which a damage fight (dummy doesn't fight back) never triggers

needsBespoke.why: All mechanics that matter for the damage fight (onhit rider, empowered attacks, target debuffs, ramping mana cost with stacks, missing-health/threshold conditional damage on R, self attack-speed buff) are expressible with the closed list of primitives.

unsettled.question: Does Void Ooze's ground trail deal any repeat damage, or only apply the slow (no additional damage ticks)?
options: The trail only slows and deals no further damage (matches both sources: only a single upfront hit is described as dealing damage)
The trail secretly deals damage per tick (unconfirmed, no bin/wiki damage value exists for it)
quotes: A field of ooze is created in its wake for 3 seconds, {{tip|slow|slowing}} enemies within the area every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

unsettled.question: Does Living Artillery's missing-health damage amplification (up to +50%) and the 40%-max-health double (+100%) stack additively/multiplicatively, or does the flat double simply override the missing-health scaling entirely when triggered?
options: The 100% bonus below 40% max health completely replaces the missing-health scaling (mechanics note states 'instead')
The two amplifications could combine (e.g., missing-health bonus applies up to the threshold, then switches) -- not explicitly ruled out by wording alone
quotes: Living Artillery's damage is increased by {{as|{{pp|...}}|health}}, or instead by {{ccs|100%|magic}} if the target is below {{as|40% '''maximum''' health}}.

unsettled.question: For a full-duration 15s dummy fight, how many R stacks (mana surcharge) does the simulator assume Kog'Maw has built up when computing sustained cast rate — starting from 0 stacks, or already capped at 9?
options: Start at 0 stacks and ramp up over the fight (realistic opener)
Assume steady-state / capped 9 stacks throughout for a 'sustained DPS' comparison
quotes: '''Kog'Maw''' then generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Living Artillery'' for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 9 times.
For each stack, ''Living Artillery's'' {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} is increased by {{as|40|mana}}.

unsettled.question: Does Bio-Arcane Barrage's bonus on-hit damage apply on every basic attack during its 8s window, or is it capped to a limited number of attacks (e.g. one empowered attack) as 'empowers his basic attacks' could be read either way?
options: Applies to every basic attack landed during the full 8s duration (matches 'for the next 8 seconds' wording, standard reading)
Only empowers a limited number of attacks (not supported by sources, but flagged since 'empowered-attack' primitive usually implies a single/limited arming)
quotes: empowers his [[basic attack]]s for the next 8 seconds to gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' attack range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}

proposal: Pre-cast: activate Bio-Arcane Barrage (W) immediately to arm basic attacks with the max-health on-hit magic damage for its 8s window.
Open with Void Ooze (E) on cooldown for its upfront magic damage plus the armor/magic-resist shred setup (via Q) to maximize follow-up damage.
Cast Caustic Spittle (Q) on cooldown to apply the resistance shred and take advantage of its own attack-speed passive that is always active once ranked.
Auto-attack continuously between casts (basic attack timer applies to Q), benefiting from W's on-hit damage and Q's attack-speed passive.

Cast Living Artillery (R) on cooldown as mana allows, prioritizing casts before the stacking mana surcharge (ramping-per-cast) makes further casts unaffordable; re-cast W when its 17s cooldown comes up again mid-fight.
Re-apply E and Q on cooldown throughout the 15s window, weaving them between auto-attacks to keep the resistance shred active continuously on the dummy.
questions: Should R be cast as fast as its 1-2s cooldown allows (spamming until mana runs out), or held back to avoid stacking cost so high that mana is exhausted before the fight ends?

Is mana treated as effectively unlimited for this simulated dummy fight (i.e., does the simulator assume max mana/mana regen items), or is realistic base mana pool assumed, which would materially cap R casts given its ramping cost?

Does the target dummy's health ever drop below the 40% and 60% missing-health thresholds during the fight, which would change which R damage tier applies over the course of the 15s (relevant since damage ranks in the sim are based on kill time against varying dummy health)?
Should the rotation prioritize W's on-hit rider (scales with target max HP, best against high-HP dummy) over spamming R, or is R generally the higher DPS component to prioritize?
